messages:
sara: Quick intake - planning bring-up for orca-lite-3b (FP16 -> INT8 experiments). Need a deployment checklist + prioritized rollout for hosted, Dedicated, and a private customer pilot. Target: low-cost tier for batch/assistant workloads.

miguel: Can we add eval baselines first? need: quality on our eval suite, embedding drift, and latency/cost targets. Also: dataset slices (conv, code, single-turn) to watch.

dalia: +1. Recommend quant profiles: int8-qs8 and int8-q2 with fallback to orca-3b-fp16. Plan: canary hosted, smoke on Dedicated reserved pool, manual push for Private (customer ops).

ryan: Metrics to watch during canary: p95 latency, median latency, tokens/sec, token cost delta, and eval-quality-change (micro-F1 / instruction accuracy). A/B strategy: 5% canary -> 20% -> 50% with automated gates.

jen: Draft rollout policy (we'll use this as the SRE config):
```json
{ "stages": ["canary", "ramp", "full"], "canary": {"traffic_pct": 5, "duration_hours": 48}, "gates": {"quality_drop_pct": 3, "p95_multiplier": 1.3} }
```

infra-bot: Deployment artifact built: rwi-orca-lite-3b-int8:v1. SHA: abc123. Scheduled window: 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC (low traffic).

sara: Pre-rollout checklist (high level):
- perf microbench on target hardware (FP32/FP16 vs INT8)
- run eval suite (conv/code/single-turn) and store baseline
- run safety/regression tests (toxicity, hallucination subset)
- KV cache priming plan for canary
- define rollback (auto + manual) and notification hooks
- customer comms for Dedicated & Private pilots

miguel: For perf microbench, let's use these quick commands:
```bash
./bench --model rwi-orca-lite-3b-int8:v1 --seq 512 --batch 4 --iters 500
```
Collect p95 and throughput. Add quantization memory checks.

dalia: Canary gating proposal: 48h min, auto rollback if any of:
- eval quality drop > 3% on primary suite
- p95 latency > baseline * 1.3 for two consecutive 1h windows
- token cost increase > 10% for 4h
Also: if quality borderline (1-3%), route failing queries to fp16 fallback variant. Use tag-based routing: `model:orca-lite-3b-fallback`.

ryan: Dedicated smoke test plan: schedule reserved pool test, run 100 QPS steady for 10m, then 400 QPS burst for 2m. Verify KV cache hit rate >= 70% and no OOMs.

jen: Private deployment notes: One customer requires HSM KMS and air-gapped package. We'll do a dry-run on staging infra, then coordinate a weekday maintenance window. Owner: assign @dalia for rollout comms and @miguel for eval signoff.

infra-bot: Canary started: 5% hosted traffic -> rwi-orca-lite-3b-int8:v1. Monitoring: /dash/model/orca-lite-3b/canary. Alerts: p95>baseline*1.3, eval-delta>3%.

sara: I'll kick off perf bench and eval runs this afternoon. tagging @ryan for dedicated smoke schedule, @jen to confirm rollback playbook. :thumbsup:

miguel: I'll assemble the eval report and set thresholds. Expect first pass in ~6 hours.

jen: Acked, prepping runbook and postmortem template in case.

sara: Great. Keeping thread for updates — please post short notes when each gate completes.
